bullets.text: Engineered a production LLM service using prompt engineering to draft three reply options for every customer review, applying sentiment-conditioned prompts with custom per-dealership rules; dealers pick and publish responses, with 93% of drafts published unedited across over 100k reviews a month.

Executed LLM fine-tuning on Llama 3 with an 8B model distilled from 70B generated examples using LoRA and QLoRA via Unsloth to enforce strict client rules that base models failed to follow, preserving speed and cost.

Deployed model services on AWS EC2 using Docker, configuring NVIDIA drivers and Linux from scratch; led migration to an on-prem GPU server and implemented database-level caching of repeat requests to reduce latency and operating costs.
